description: InternVL-U (generation_decoder / vae / vlm) at the public ungated original's pinned revision. THE F32 ISLAND IS REAL: 36 of the generation decoder's 654 tensors — the whole of transformer_blocks.19 plus norm_out and proj_out — ship F32 on an otherwise bf16 tree, so both the hub row and upstream advertise a flat bf16 that is wrong at tensor granularity. Recorded as islands, which is exactly what makes plain.bf16 admit the reference.
name: internvl-u.diffusers
